title: Does red-cell heterogeneity modify the predictive value of eosinophils for airflow? A cross-cycle interaction test
abstract: Adding a sex-specific centered RDW-by-eosinophil product to flexible standard-measure models changed NHANES2011-2012 FEV1/FVC weighted MSE by -0.000001899; joint bootstrap95% [-0.000024126,+0.000042651], after fitting NHANES2007-2008. The registered incremental-prediction criterion was not met; this is not an equivalence test. This tests joint representation of known markers, not a new biological measurement. Independent recruitment cycles share a platform; the reused target is not untouched confirmation. No clinical utility or causal mechanism is established.
